name: Scotch Shortbread
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Measure out the ingredients, put the butter and sugar in a basin, beat to a cream
Make a hole in the centre of the mixture and add the yolk of the egg
Mix flour and baking powder well together and add gradually to the butter and sugar, mixing well
Turn out on a floured pastry board and work the mixture into flat, round shapes about as large as saucers
Notch the edges or place on a wooden shape or earthenware mould and bake in a slow oven for twenty minutes till a nice brown color

source.originalInstructions:
1. Measure out the ingredients, put the butter and sugar in a basin, beat to a cream
2. Make a hole in the centre of the mixture and add the yolk of the egg
3. Mix flour and baking powder well together and add gradually to the butter and sugar, mixing well
4. Turn out on a floured pastry board and work the mixture into flat, round shapes about as large as saucers
5. Notch the edges or place on a wooden shape or earthenware mould and bake in a slow oven for twenty minutes till a nice brown color
